sql:
WITH q_data AS (
  SELECT
    IF(DATE(oi.created_at) >= DATE '2025-01-01', 'Q1 2025', 'Q4 2024') AS quarter,
    oi.order_id,
    oi.user_id,
    oi.sale_price,
    oi.status,
    p.cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  WHERE DATE(oi.created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
)
SELECT
  quarter,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), sale_price, 0)), 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), sale_price - cost, 0)), 2) AS margin,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), order_id, NULL)) AS orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), user_id, NULL)) AS customers,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), sale_price, 0)), COUNT(DISTINCT IF(status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), order_id, NULL))), 2) AS aov,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(status = 'Returned'), COUNTIF(status != 'Cancelled')) * 100, 1) AS return_rate_pct
FROM q_data
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter DESC

SELECT
  p.category,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(DATE(oi.created_at) >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), oi.sale_price, 0)), 2) AS revenue_q1_2025,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(DATE(oi.created_at) < DATE '2025-01-01' AND oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), oi.sale_price, 0)), 2) AS revenue_q4_2024,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(DATE(oi.created_at) >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), oi.sale_price, 0)),
    SUM(IF(DATE(oi.created_at) < DATE '2025-01-01' AND oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), oi.sale_price, 0))
  ) - 1, 4) AS growth_qoq
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE DATE(oi.created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue_q1_2025 DESC

sql:
SELECT
  p.brand,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue,
  COUNTIF(oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')) AS units_sold,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND DATE(oi.created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3
